evidence: Board search does filter once the cookie-consent modal is dismissed and the Country/Region facet checkbox (not just the ?location= URL param) is used: 'software engineer' -> 171 global / 31 United States results. All 31 US hits are Production/Reliability/Instrument Control/Quality/Sales/R&D roles (e.g. 'Reliability Engineer', '2027 Agricultural Solutions Professional Development Program - Engineering'); none is a Software Engineer/Developer or other SWE-track title. No US software engineering new-grad program found; BASF's tech entry programs remain Germany-based as previously suspected.
